digest.component_or_area: code-review runtime and project criteria execution
propositions: Project-configured code-review criteria merge successfully but never execute or evaluate, appearing as silent failures indistinguishable from passing rubrics.
The code-review runtime lacks a dynamic fan-in pattern to execute activated project criteria in Pass 1, reusing only the static workflow list without consulting repository-effective routing.
Project prompt and eval assets must resolve from the reviewed repository snapshot, with missing or malformed assets raising a fatal LLMError before model execution.
The logical-to-physical criterion id mapping must translate project.<name> to code-review-project-<name> for asset dispatch while preserving logical ids in findings and routing.
Pass 3 decision logic must apply repository-effective threshold, blocking posture, and nit-suppression using deterministic routing lookups without invoking the LLM.
